season.leap_rule: the axis has no Feb 29; the Feb 28 slot holds Feb 28's own value and Feb 29 is added to nothing, but it still counts toward completeness (a leap water year needs 366 valued days)

base.rule: every qualifying season, full record, excluding the current season: >= 0.90 of the days in the window carry a value

enso.mapping: water year N (Oct 1 N-1 → Sep 30 N) → ENSO year N-1

now.basis: El Niño developing, latest ONI 1.8 (JJA), 4 seasons; a label for the current state, read from CPC's index as the catalog banks it; not a forecast

source.method: The sum of the region's member reservoirs' daily storage, in thousand acre-feet; a day carries a value only when every member reports (never renormalised).
